meta.purpose: Real cost sheet required by 01 §17. It holds only amounts that are actually known from evidence. Existing subscriptions count as existing costs, not as free.
rules: amount is null unless the value is known from evidence (an invoice, a checkout, provider metering, or a plan rule that fixes it at 0).
No price is estimated, and earlier CAD estimates are not recycled (01 §2).
Regional checkout is the price source of truth; some Google pages display USD for a Canadian link (07 S4).
Nothing is bought, subscribed to or spent before G2 records a cap (01 §4; tasks.json meta.spend_authorization).
currency is null until an actual invoice or checkout fixes it.
The director appends each run's usage to measured_usage from .orchestration/runs/*.json. A price is recorded only when the provider meters one.

status_legend.existing_cost_unknown: The service or cost already exists, or the existing code or stack already depends on it while its account status is unknown (see account_existence on the item); its actual amount is not recorded yet.
status_legend.not_purchased: A candidate paid item or cost that is not incurred. Incurring it needs the named gate.
status_legend.not_selected: An option not chosen, or one excluded by the plan. It costs nothing unless it is explicitly selected.
status_legend.zero_authorized: The plan's default either has no subscription charge or its spend line is capped at 0 until G2 records a cap. amount 0 means nothing is spent or subscribed, not that the vendor's price will never change.
status_legend.measured: The amount comes from an actual invoice or provider metering. No item has this status yet.

email_capacity_check.daily_provider_limit_basis: Brevo Free, all message types share the credits (07 S11; recheck at signup)
email_capacity_check.busiest_day_formula: 2 reminders × registrants + guide deliveries + receipts + other operational sends on the same day, plus any nurture
email_capacity_check.rule: Keep a configurable soft daily budget below the provider limit, with capacity reserved for operational messages. Compute it once the event cap (HB-17) is known.

triggers: Expected email volume exceeds safe daily capacity
Storage or egress reaches the chosen warning band
Backup or availability requirement is no longer met
Paid meetings displace valuable client work
upgrade_triggers.never: Run fake traffic to evade inactivity policies, or split accounts to evade quotas.
